mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS <=0.1%, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise >0.3pp in 3 months), or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE >5%) and stable interest rates (FEDFUNDS >=0.1%) indicate a weak economy without monetary support, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: weak economy with no monetary easing
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE >5% and FEDFUNDS >=0.1%, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong annualized GDP growth exceeding 2% (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with GDPC1 annualized growth >2%, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY >3.5%), or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates rising economic activity and capacity utilization, compressing equity risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of months with INDPRO increase, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market downturn (HOUST <1600 thousand units) reflects weak consumer demand and economic uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with HOUST <1600, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% (FEDFUNDS) signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS >0.5%, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year window.
